claimBoundaries: Seed fixture for schema and report validation only.

readinessChecks.interpretation: A credible benchmark needs systems submitted by people other than the author.
The scaffold still needs at least one production-grade personal-agent run.
Tool traces are necessary because personal-agent failures often happen at action boundaries.

blockers: independent-external-baseline: A credible benchmark needs systems submitted by people other than the author.
production-personal-agent-baseline: The scaffold still needs at least one production-grade personal-agent run.
limitations: Seed baseline submissions exercise the contract but are not independent evidence.
Scenario coverage from a submission report is only meaningful when run artifacts are attached.
External submissions must include enough trace evidence to audit data movement, not only final scores.
